entities.name: Vren, the Relentless
entities.description: A legendary ratfolk rogue from Bloomburrow who recycles scavenged goods and leads a large gang.

entities.name: Calamity Beasts
entities.description: Giant beasts whose trails Vren follows for salvage.

relations.note: follows their trails to scavenge, and sells arms to drive them off
relations.quote: He has a penchant for following closely behind the trails of Calamity Beasts
